complete_row_replication.result: PASS under the stated pointwise-normalization assumption
complete_row_replication.reasoning: For each relation r, L_r(X)=b_r+sum_i w_r(x_i)u_r(x_i)/sum_i w_r(x_i), where x_i includes H, R and validity mask. Replacing every valid complete row by k identical copies scales both sums by k. All 40 logits and therefore the complete softmax vector stay unchanged. This requires one parameter setting across cardinalities and a nonzero denominator; epsilon-positive weights and at least one valid row supply the latter here. Entity rows must be duplicated too.

context_permutation_law.definition: Uniformly average all (2k)! permutations of eligible context indices, including identity; leave the 2k entity rows fixed. Repeated numerical weights retain their index multiplicities.
context_permutation_law.law: There are k high and k low context weights. The number J of high weights assigned to the k A utility positions has P(J=j)=C(k,j)^2/C(2k,k), j=0,...,k. Thus Z=b+(a-b)J/k, E[Z]=m and Var(Z)=(a-b)^2/[4(2k-1)].
context_permutation_law.small_cases: k=1 gives masses (1/2,1/2) at (b,a); k=2 gives (1/6,2/3,1/6) at (b,m,a); k=3 gives (1,9,9,1)/20. The stated rational variances and interior k=3 support values are consistent.

full40_jensen_sign.reasoning: With the other 39 logits exactly zero, the target probability is f(z)=exp(z)/(exp(z)+39), and each other probability is (1-f(z))/39. Here f''(z)=39 exp(z)(39-exp(z))/(exp(z)+39)^3>0 on [b,a], since exp(z)<e<3<39. Consequently M1-M2=[f(a)+f(b)-2f(m)]/3>0. The target coordinate and hence the full40 vector differ. Every candidate native function has equal outputs on X and its complete duplication, so none can equal this mixture function on both inputs.
full40_jensen_sign.limitation: The sign uses this chosen full40 logit configuration. No global convexity of softmax, arbitrary-logit Jensen sign, or binary-softmax inference is needed.

limiting_bias.result: PASS with an explicit reference value
limiting_bias.reasoning: Let c_min and c_max be the minimum and maximum of f'' on [b,a]. Taylor expansion about m and E[Z-m]=0 give c_min Var(Z)/2 <= E[f(Z)]-f(m) <= c_max Var(Z)/2. Both constants are finite and positive. This is a positive Jensen gap of order 1/(2k-1), tending to zero relative to f(m). It does not tend to zero relative to the original native probability f(a), because m<a and f is increasing.

native_realizability.result: Circuit construction is mathematically valid under the supplied circuit description; full source-level realization is not independently certified
native_realizability.circuit_reasoning: Set every effect and every preparation output to zero except the first-layer first-wire RY output. For H_B=e_B, give that preparation coordinate coefficient atanh(1/2) on e_B and zero bias/role coefficients. Its angle is pi*tanh(atanh(1/2))=pi/2; the other three rows produce angle zero. Every parameter used is finite. The zero-angle effect prepares |000>. CNOT rings are invertible basis permutations fixing |000>, so a nonzero basis branch never reaches |000>. Therefore the B overlap squared is cos(pi/4)^2=1/2, while the other overlaps are 1. Under the checker's explicit bit convention, |100> maps to |011> then |010>, consistent with its recorded integer 2. That particular integer is unnecessary for the overlap proof.
native_realizability.all40_requirement: Set all 40 class effects to zero so the same q weights apply in every class. Set all class biases to zero and all non-target decoder rows to zero.
native_realizability.utility_factorization: If the native value map is an unrestricted affine/linear map with at least one value channel, choose value(e_A)=v with ||v||=1 and value(e_B)=value(e_subject)=value(e_object)=0; set its bias to zero and the target decoder row to v. This is a finite rank-one realization of utilities (1,0,0,0). Freeze these same value/decoder/bias parameters for every replication and every candidate comparison.
native_realizability.explicit_assumption: The packet supplies decoder dot value(h), but does not expose the actual value-map implementation. The finite utility factorization above is conditional on that parameterization permitting these outputs. The checker supplies a utility list rather than constructing native value/decoder parameters. A hidden value constraint could invalidate this particular fixture and must be checked against the actual source before asserting an unconditional source-native realization.

required_corrections.correction: Add an explicit finite value/decoder parameter construction and identify the native value-map parameterization that admits it. Until this mapping is checked in the source, retain the conditional head-API verdict and avoid describing the rational checker as an executed native forward.
Define the vanishing mixture bias as E[f(Z_k)]-f(m). Its limiting reference is the mean-logit probability f(m), not the original native probability f(a). The latter discrepancy persists.

When presenting the result, keep the existential closure claim, common-parameter variable-cardinality domain, complete H/R/mask duplication including entities, and uniform averaging over all eligible index permutations explicit.
